executiveSummary: The OT/ICS threat picture is elevated to CRITICAL due to concurrent, validated exploitation of internet-exposed PLCs in the Water and Wastewater Systems sector and a separate joint advisory attributing logic tampering against Allen-Bradley, Schneider, and Siemens controllers to Iranian-affiliated actors. These events include password/parameter manipulation, alarm suppression, and operational impacts requiring manual operations and boil-water notices. Security Advisory Security Advisory Enterprise edge devices and management planes widely used by critical infrastructure are under active attack. Public exploits and observed compromises affect Citrix NetScaler (pre-auth SAML RCE), VMware vCenter (backdoors/admin creation), Metabase (SQLi zero-day), and JetBrains TeamCity (RCE)-all strong IT-to-OT pivot avenues if segmentation is weak. Security Advisory Advisory Fortinet FortiGate credential leakage ("FortiBleed") at global scale presents immediate perimeter risk; multiple sources confirm still-valid credentials and suspected AD abuse. Rapid rotation, PBKDF2 enforcement, and compromise hunting are required. Security Advisory OT-relevant KEVs and weekly bulletins highlight exploitable components in industrial environments: OPC UA (Eclipse Milo), PcVue HMI, EV DC fast chargers (remote takeover), ICS monitoring (CISA Malcolm), BMS controllers, and OT segmentation gateways with hardcoded keys (JCI Airwall). CISA Bulletin CISA Bulletin ICS Advisory Adversaries continue to leverage covert proxy networks and router misconfigurations to obfuscate origin and stage access against CNI. Recent multi-nation guidance details Chinese groups' covert device networks and Russian FSB Center 16 tactics against SNMP/TFTP and Smart Install. Security Advisory Security Advisory

descriptions: Initial Access: Exploitation of public-facing applications/devices (NetScaler SAML pre-auth RCE; vCenter traversal; TeamCity deserialization; Metabase SQLi) [ATT&CK T1190].
Valid Accounts & Default Credentials: FortiGate leaked creds; exposed VNC with weak/no auth [T1078, T1110].
Lateral Movement: RDP/SMB/Impacket within IT, pivot to ICS DMZ; abuse of identity gateways [T1021].
Command & Control: Covert proxy networks (SOHO/IoT), cloud services (Graph/OneDrive) [T1090, T1102].
Impact (ICS ATT&CK): Modify Control Logic (T0831), Manipulate I/O (T0830), Inhibit Alarm Function (T0826), Loss of View (T0814).

outlook72h: High likelihood of opportunistic scanning and exploitation against NetScaler ADC/Gateway and Metabase given public PoCs and active exploitation campaigns-treat exposed instances as compromised until proven otherwise. Expect continued PLC targeting in small/medium utilities; verify all remote access paths including cellular/third-party modems and private APNs. Prioritize KEV remediation on internet-facing assets (ASA/FTD, vCenter, TeamCity, OPC UA implementations, OpenSearch plugins) and conduct compromise assessments pre/post patching.
